$comment: Mixer, master dynamics and propagation. Buses: engines, aero, reentry, events, cabin, ui -> master (compressor, limiter, soft ceiling below 1.0). fadeAboveWarp buses fade to exact silence over warp.fadeTime when warpFactor > warp.threshold. propagation: airborne gain (p / referencePressure)^pressureGainExponent (0 in vacuum), low-pass cutoff from pressure and from distance (air absorption), inverse-distance attenuation beyond the source's refDistance, propagation delay d / (speedOfSound + recession speed), faded out between airborneFadeStart and airborneFadeEnd. hull: what of the airborne path reaches a cabin listener. structure: attenuation along the vessel for structure-borne sound. attach: the faint structure-borne share an external camera near the vessel hears. The DynamicsCompressorNode adds its own makeup gain (0.6 x its gain reduction at 0 dBFS, about +4.5 dB here); compressor.makeupDb cancels it so quiet scenes (a vacuum burn heard through the hull) stay quiet.
